name: bahaospanov
description: Bakhtiyar Ospanov's Claude Code mods, built on function hooks.

plugins.name: git-gates
plugins.description: Gates git work on the user's word: no commit, push, MR opening or merge without their say-so in the current turn, a protected branch named, a grant for a commit per task; a negated keyword does not count.

plugins.name: git-tidy
plugins.description: Keeps git history tidy: commit messages in Conventional Commits with no Claude credit, then a Haiku review of the body; a push to a branch that already landed is refused; an MR whose branch lacks the target's latest commit is refused; a pushed series must leave the project working at every commit; follow-up commits and MRs carrying several features are held for the user.

plugins.name: git-cleanup
plugins.description: Cleans up after merged work, once it shipped: removing a branch needs git, the forge or the user to say it merged; removing it or filling in its issue waits for the pipeline holding it to pass; merged, clean work gets a one-line notice and is removed when the user asks.

plugins.name: issue-first
plugins.description: Feature work starts from an issue, and each commit names its own: a feat commit naming none is refused until Claude finds the issue, drafts one the user agrees to, or the user says it needs none; a commit whose subject does not end with the issue the user or the branch named gets a suggestion.

plugins.name: lean-docs
plugins.description: Docs worth keeping: docs-review asks Haiku whether new text will be read again, docs-no-repeat-code flags lines that may restate code, limit-docs sends a follow-up when a turn adds too much prose.

plugins.name: lean-comments
plugins.description: Comments worth keeping: limit-edits flags comment-heavy edits, limit-turns sends a follow-up when a turn's diff adds too many comments.

plugins.name: lean-scripts
plugins.description: Scripts worth keeping: scripts-review asks Haiku whether a new script could just be typed again when needed.

plugins.name: bahaospanov-skills
plugins.description: Every skill in this repo's skills/ folder.
